ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْۚ اِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa'ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakum inna zalzalatas-saa'ati shay'un 'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: O people, be conscious of your Lord. The quaking of the Hour is a tremendous thing.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَـٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَـٰرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَـٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَـٰرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا͏ٓ اَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَي النَّاسَ سُكٰرٰي وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكٰرٰي وَلٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللّٰهِ شَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tarawnahaa tadhhalu kullu murdi'atin 'ammaa arda'at watada'u kullu dhaati hamlin hamlahaa wataran-naasa sukaaraa wamaa hum bisukaaraa walaakinna 'adhaaballaahi shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when you will see it: every nursing mother will discard her infant, and every pregnant woman will abort her load, and you will see the people drunk, even though they are not drunk—but the punishment of Allah is severe.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَادِلُ فِي اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطٰنٍ مَّرِيْدٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
ayahs.transliteration: Waminan-naasi man yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri 'ilmin wayattabi'u kulla shaytaanim mareed
ayahs.translationClear: Among the people is he who argues about Allah without knowledge, and follows every defiant devil.

ayahs.textUthmani: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَاَنَّهٗ يُضِلُّهٗ وَيَهْدِيْهِ اِلٰي عَذَابِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Kutiba 'alayhi annahoo man tawallaahu fa'annahoo yudilluhoo wayahdeehi ilaa 'adhaabis-sa'eer
ayahs.translationClear: It was decreed for him, that whoever follows him—he will misguide him, and lead him to the torment of the Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ‌ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ‌ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا‌ۚ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِيْ رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَاِنَّا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَّغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْؕ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْاَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَا࢜ءُ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوْٓا اَشُدَّكُمْۚ وَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّتَوَفّٰي وَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّرَدُّ اِلٰٓي اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـٔ͏ًاؕ وَتَرَي الْاَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَاِذَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَا࢜ءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَاَنۢ͏ْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ بَهِيْجٍ
ayahs.translation: O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed[915] - that We may show you.[916] And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa'ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee raybim minal-ba'thi fa'innaa khalaqnaakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma mim mudghatim mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fil-arhaami maa nashaa'u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffaa waminkum man yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-'umuri likaylaa ya'lama mim ba'di 'ilmin shay'an wataral-arda haamidatan fa'idhaa anzalnaa 'alayhal-maa'ahtazzat warabat wa'ambatat min kulli zawjim baheej

footnotes.915: That which is incomplete. This may include what is aborted at that stage.

ayahs.translationClear: O people! If you are in doubt about the Resurrection—We created you from dust, then from a small drop, then from a clinging clot, then from a lump of flesh, partly developed and partly undeveloped. In order to clarify things for you. And We settle in the wombs whatever We will for a designated term, and then We bring you out as infants, until you reach your full strength. And some of you will pass away, and some of you will be returned to the vilest age, so that he may not know, after having known. And you see the earth still; but when We send down water on it, it vibrates, and swells, and grows all kinds of lovely pairs.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنَّهٗ يُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰي وَاَنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'annahoo yuhyil-mawtaa wa'annahoo 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: That is because Allah is the truth, and because He gives life to the dead, and because He is Capable of everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهَاۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'annas-saa'ata aatiyatul laa rayba feehaa wa'annallaaha yab'athu man fil-quboor
ayahs.translationClear: And because the Hour is coming—there is no doubt about it—and because Allah will resurrect those in the graves.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَـٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَـٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَادِلُ فِي اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّلَا هُدًي وَّلَا كِتٰبٍ مُّنِيْرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
ayahs.transliteration: Waminan-naasi man yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri 'ilmin walaa hudan walaa kitaabim muneer
ayahs.translationClear: And among the people is he who argues about Allah without knowledge, or guidance, or an enlightening scripture.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ‌ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهٖ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِؕ لَهٗ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَّنُذِيْقُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيْقِ

words.translation: and We will make him taste

ayahs.translation: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
ayahs.transliteration: Thaaniya 'itfihee liyudilla 'an sabeelillaahi lahoo fid-dunyaa khizyun wanudheequhoo yawmal-qiyaamati 'adhaabal-hareeq
ayahs.translationClear: Turning aside in contempt, to lead away from the path of Allah. He will have humiliation in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make him taste the agony of burning.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰكَ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat yadaaka wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil'abeed
ayahs.translationClear: That is for what your hands have advanced, and because Allah is not unjust to the servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ‌ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ‌ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَّعْبُدُ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي حَرْفٍۚ فَاِنْ اَصَابَهٗ خَيْرُ اࣙطْمَاَنَّ بِهٖۚ وَاِنْ اَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةُ اࣙنْقَلَبَ عَلٰي وَجْهِهٖࣞۚ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.translation: And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge.[917] If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
ayahs.transliteration: Waminan-naasi man ya'budullaaha 'alaa harfin fa'in asaabahoo khayrunitma'anna bihee wa'in asaabat'hu fitnatuninqalaba 'alaa wajhihee khasirad-dunyaa wal-aakhirata dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen

footnotes.917: At the edge of his religion, so to speak, i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy or heedlessness.

ayahs.translationClear: And among the people is he who worships Allah on edge. When something good comes his way, he is content with it. But when an ordeal strikes him, he makes a turnaround. He loses this world and the next. That is the obvious loss.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَدْعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهٗ وَمَا لَا يَنْفَعُهٗؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ الْبَعِيْدُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
ayahs.transliteration: Yad'oo min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhoo wamaa laa yanfa'uhoo dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: He invokes, instead of Allah, what can neither harm him nor benefit him. That is the far straying.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ ۚ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ‌ۚ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَدْعُوْا لَمَنْ ضَرُّهٗٓ اَقْرَبُ مِنْ نَّفْعِهٖؕ لَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمَوْلٰي وَلَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْعَشِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
ayahs.transliteration: Yad'oo laman darruhoo aqrabu min naf'ihee labi'sal-mawlaa walabi'sal-'asheer
ayahs.translationClear: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit. What a miserable master. What a miserable companion.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.
ayahs.transliteration: Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru innallaaha yaf'alu maa yureed
ayahs.translationClear: Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Allah does whatever He wills.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: مَنْ كَانَ يَظُنُّ اَنْ لَّنْ يَّنْصُرَهُ اللّٰهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ اِلَي السَّمَا࢜ءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنْظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهٗ مَا يَغِيْظُ
ayahs.translation: Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath],[918] and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
ayahs.transliteration: Man kaana yazunnu al lan yansurahullaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samaa'i thumma lyaqta' falyanzur hal yudhhibanna kayduhoo maa yagheez
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever thinks that Allah will not help him in this life and in the Hereafter—let him turn to heaven, then sever, and see if his cunning eliminates what enrages him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنٰتٍۙ وَّاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَهْدِيْ مَنْ يُّرِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu aayaatim bayyinaatin wa'annallaaha yahdee man yureed
ayahs.translationClear: Thus We revealed it as clarifying signs, and Allah guides whomever He wills.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَالَّذِيْنَ هَادُوْا وَالصّٰبِـِٕيْنَ وَالنَّصٰرٰي وَالْمَجُوْسَ وَالَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْٓاࣗۖ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.[919]
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'eena wan-nasaaraa wal-majoosa wal-ladheena ashrakoo innallaaha yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
ayahs.translationClear: Those who believe, and those who are Jewish, and the Sabeans, and the Christians, and the Zoroastrians, and the polytheists—Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Allah is Witness to all things.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ‌ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ‌ۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۩ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهٗ مَنْ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُوْمُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَا࢜بُّ وَكَثِيْرٌ مِّنَ النَّاسِؕ وَكَثِيْرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابُؕ وَمَنْ يُّهِنِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ مُّكْرِمٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُ ࣛؕ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified.[920] And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara annallaaha yasjudu lahoo man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujoomu wal-jibaalu wash-shajaru wad-dawaabbu wakatheerum minan-naasi wakatheerun haqqa 'alayhil-'adhaabu waman yuhinillaahu famaa lahoo mim mukrimin innallaaha yaf'alu maa yashaa'u
ayahs.translationClear: Do you not realize that to Allah prostrates everyone in the heavens and everyone on earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the animals, and many of the people? But many are justly deserving of punishment. Whomever Allah shames, there is none to honor him. Allah does whatever He wills.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ هَـٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ هَـٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ‌ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذٰنِ خَصْمٰنِ اخْتَصَمُوْا فِيْ رَبِّهِمْؗ فَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّنْ نَّارٍؕ يُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوْسِهِمُ الْحَمِيْمُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: These[921] are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
ayahs.transliteration: Haadhaani khasmaanikhtasamoo fee rabbihim fal-ladheena kafaroo qutti'at lahum thiyaabum min naarin yusabbu min fawqi ru'oosihimul-hameem

footnotes.921: i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.

ayahs.translationClear: Here are two adversaries feuding regarding their Lord. As for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be tailored for them, and scalding water will be poured over their heads.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يُصْهَرُ بِهٖ مَا فِيْ بُطُوْنِهِمْ وَالْجُلُوْدُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
ayahs.transliteration: Yus'haru bihee maa fee butoonihim wal-julood
ayahs.translationClear: Melting their insides and their skins.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُم مَّقَـٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُم مَّقَـٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهُمْ مَّقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
ayahs.transliteration: Walahum maqaami'u min hadeed
ayahs.translationClear: And they will have maces of iron.

ayahs.textUthmani: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: كُلَّمَا͏ٓ اَرَادُوْٓا اَنْ يَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ اُعِيْدُوْا فِيْهَاࣗ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيْقِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"
ayahs.transliteration: Kullamaa araadoo an yakhrujoo minhaa min ghammin u'eedoo feehaa wadhooqoo 'adhaabal-hareeq
ayahs.translationClear: Whenever they try to escape the gloom, they will be driven back to it: “Taste the suffering of burning.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا‌ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيْهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّلُو͏ٔ͏ْلُو͏ٔ͏ًاؕ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيْهَا حَرِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
ayahs.transliteration: Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabin walu'lu'an walibaasuhum feehaa hareer
ayahs.translationClear: But Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be decorated therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُدُوْٓا اِلَي الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِۚۖ وَهُدُوْٓا اِلٰي صِرَاطِ الْحَمِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahudoo ilat-tayyibi minal-qawli wahudoo ilaa siraatil-hameed
ayahs.translationClear: They were guided to purity of speech. They were guided to the path of the Most Praised.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَـٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَـٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَـٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَـٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ‌ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَيَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْنٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَا࢜ءَ اࣙلْعَاكِفُ فِيْهِ وَالْبَادِؕ وَمَنْ يُّرِدْ فِيْهِ بِاِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein[922] of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wayasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi wal-masjidil-haraamil-ladhee ja'alnaahu linnaasi sawaa'anil-'aakifu feehi wal-baadi waman yurid feehi bi'ilhaadim bizulmin nudhiqhu min 'adhaabin aleem

footnotes.922: Whether inside its boundaries or intending from afar to do evil therein. The Ḥaram is unique in that the mere intention of sin therein (whether or not it is actually carried out) is sufficient to bring punishment from Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: As for those who disbelieve and repel from Allah’s path and from the Sacred Mosque—which We have designated for all mankind equally, whether residing therein or passing through—and whoever seeks to commit sacrilege therein—We will make him taste of a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذْ بَوَّاْنَا لِاِبْرٰهِيْمَ مَكَانَ الْبَيْتِ اَنْ لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِيْ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّطَهِّرْ بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّا࢜ىِٕفِيْنَ وَالْقَا࢜ىِٕمِيْنَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf[923] and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idh bawwa'naa li'ibraaheema makaanal-bayti al laa tushrik bee shay'an watahhir baytiya littaa'ifeena wal-qaa'imeena war-rukka'is-sujood
ayahs.translationClear: We showed Abraham the location of the House: “Do not associate anything with Me; and purify My House for those who circle around, and those who stand to pray, and those who kneel and prostrate.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَذِّنْ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَاْتُوْكَ رِجَالًا وَّعَلٰي كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَّاْتِيْنَ مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيْقٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'adhdhin fin-naasi bil-hajji ya'tooka rijaalan wa'alaa kulli daamirin ya'teena min kulli fajjin 'ameeq
ayahs.translationClear: And announce the pilgrimage to humanity. They will come to you on foot, and on every transport. They will come from every distant point.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَـٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَـٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَـٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَـٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ‌ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيَشْهَدُوْا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ فِيْٓ اَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُوْمٰتٍ عَلٰي مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِيْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِۚ فَكُلُوْا مِنْهَا وَاَطْعِمُوا الْبَا࢜ىِٕسَ الْفَقِيْرَ ؗ
ayahs.translation: That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals.[924] So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyashhadoo manaafi'a lahum wayadhkurusmallaahi fee ayyaamim ma'loomaatin 'alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an'aami fakuloo minhaa wa'at'imul-baa'isal-faqeer

footnotes.924: Al-anʿām: camels, cattle, sheep and goats.

ayahs.translationClear: That they may witness the benefits for themselves, and celebrate the name of Allah during the appointed days, for providing them with the animal livestock. So eat from it, and feed the unfortunate poor.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوْا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوْفُوْا نُذُوْرَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوْا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيْقِ
ayahs.translation: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nudhoorahum walyattawwafoo bil-baytil-'ateeq
ayahs.translationClear: Then let them perform their acts of cleansing, and fulfill their vows, and circle around the Ancient House.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَـٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ‌ۗ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ‌ۖ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَـٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَࣗ وَمَنْ يُّعَظِّمْ حُرُمٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖؕ وَاُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَامُ اِلَّا مَا يُتْلٰي عَلَيْكُمْ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you.[925] So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika waman yu'azzim hurumaatillaahi fahuwa khayrul lahoo 'inda rabbihee wa'uhillat lakumul-an'aamu illaa maa yutlaa 'alaykum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-awthaani wajtaniboo qawlaz-zoor
ayahs.translationClear: All that. Whoever venerates the sanctities of Allah—it is good for him with his Lord. All livestock are permitted to you, except what is recited to you. So stay away from the abomination of idols, and stay away from perjury.

ayahs.textUthmani: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ‌ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: حُنَفَا࢜ءَ لِلّٰهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِيْنَ بِهٖؕ وَمَنْ يُّشْرِكْ بِاللّٰهِ فَكَاَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ اَوْ تَهْوِيْ بِهِ الرِّيْحُ فِيْ مَكَانٍ سَحِيْقٍ
ayahs.translation: Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
ayahs.transliteration: Hunafaa'a lillaahi ghayra mushrikeena bihee waman yushrik billaahi faka'annamaa kharra minas-samaa'i fatakhtafuhut-tayru aw tahwee bihir-reehu fee makaanin saheeq
ayahs.translationClear: Being true to Allah, without associating anything with Him. Whoever associates anything with Allah—it is as though he has fallen from the sky, and is snatched by the birds, or is swept away by the wind to a distant abyss.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَࣗ وَمَنْ يُّعَظِّمْ شَعَا࢜ىِٕرَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَي الْقُلُوْبِ
ayahs.translation: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika waman yu'azzim sha'aa'irallaahi fa'innahaa min taqwal-quloob
ayahs.translationClear: So it is. Whoever venerates the sacraments of Allah—it is from the piety of the hearts.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَنَافِعُ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا͏ٓ اِلَي الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيْقِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term;[926] then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.[927]
ayahs.transliteration: Lakum feehaa manaafi'u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma mahilluhaa ilal-baytil-'ateeq

footnotes.926: i.e., they may be milked or ridden (in the case of camels) before the time of slaughter.
footnotes.927: i.e., within the boundaries of the Ḥaram, which includes Minā.

ayahs.translationClear: In them are benefits for you until a certain time. Then their place is by the Ancient House.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۗ فَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ‌ۗ فَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟‌ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلٰي مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِيْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِؕ فَاِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَلَهٗٓ اَسْلِمُوْاؕ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice][928] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
ayahs.transliteration: Walikulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakal liyadhkurusmallaahi 'alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an'aami fa'ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun falahoo aslimoo wabashshiril-mukhbiteen

footnotes.928: i.e., the rite of sacrifice has always been a part of Allāh's revealed religion.

ayahs.translationClear: We have appointed a rite for every nation, that they may commemorate Allah’s name over the livestock He has provided for them. Your god is One God, so to Him submit, and announce good news to the humble.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَالصّٰبِرِيْنَ عَلٰي مَا͏ٓ اَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيْمِي الصَّلٰوةِۙ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena idhaa dhukirallaahu wajilat quloobuhum was-saabireena 'alaa maa asaabahum wal-muqeemis-salaati wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, and those who endure what has befallen them, and those who perform the prayer and spend from what We have provided for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ ۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَـٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ‌ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ‌ۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَـٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنٰهَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ شَعَا࢜ىِٕرِ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا خَيْرٌࣗۖ فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَا࢜فَّۚ فَاِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوْبُهَا فَكُلُوْا مِنْهَا وَاَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّؕ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ

words.translation: the needy who do not ask

ayahs.translation: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-budna ja'alnaahaa lakum min sha'aa'irillaahi lakum feehaa khayrun fadhkurusmallaahi 'alayhaa sawaaffa fa'idhaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakuloo minhaa wa'at'imul-qaani'a wal-mu'tarra kadhaalika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: We have made the animal offerings emblems of Allah for you. In them is goodness for you. So pronounce Allah’s name upon them as they line up. Then, when they have fallen on their sides, eat of them and feed the contented and the beggar. Thus We have subjected them to you, that you may be thankful.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَـٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَـٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ‌ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَنْ يَّنَالَ اللّٰهَ لُحُوْمُهَا وَلَا دِمَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُهَا وَلٰكِنْ يَّنَالُهُ التَّقْوٰي مِنْكُمْؕ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللّٰهَ عَلٰي مَا هَدٰىكُمْؕ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.
ayahs.transliteration: Lan yanaalallaaha luhoomuhaa walaa dimaa'uhaa walaakin yanaaluhut-taqwaa minkum kadhaalika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbirullaaha 'alaa maa hadaakum wabashshiril-muhsineen
ayahs.translationClear: Neither their flesh, nor their blood, ever reaches Allah. What reaches Him is the righteousness from you. Thus He subdued them to you, that you may glorify Allah for guiding you. And give good news to the charitable.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدٰفِعُ عَنِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُوْرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Innallaaha yudaafi'u 'anil-ladheena aamanoo innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla khawwaanin kafoor
ayahs.translationClear: Allah defends those who believe. Allah does not love any ungrateful traitor.

ayahs.textUthmani: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟‌ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اُذِنَ لِلَّذِيْنَ يُقٰتَلُوْنَ بِاَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوْاؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought,[929] because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.
ayahs.transliteration: Udhina lilladheena yuqaataloona bi'annahum zulimoo wa'innallaaha 'alaa nasrihim laqadeer

footnotes.929: Referring here to the Prophet's companions.

ayahs.translationClear: Permission is given to those who are fought against, and Allah is Able to give them victory.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَـٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ‌ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَـٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا‌ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلَّذِيْنَ اُخْرِجُوْا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يَّقُوْلُوْا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللّٰهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَامِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَّصَلَوٰتٌ وَّمَسٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيْهَا اسْمُ اللّٰهِ كَثِيْرًاؕ وَلَيَنْصُرَنَّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّنْصُرُهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيْزٌ
ayahs.translation: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim bighayri haqqin illaa an yaqooloo rabbunallaahu walawlaa daf'ullaahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'dil lahuddimat sawaami'u wabiya'un wasalawaatun wamasaajidu yudhkaru feehasmullaahi katheeran walayansurannallaahu man yansuruhoo innallaaha laqawiyyun 'azeez
ayahs.translationClear: Those who were unjustly evicted from their homes, merely for saying, “Our Lord is Allah.” Were it not that Allah repels people by means of others: monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques—where the name of Allah is mentioned much—would have been demolished. Allah supports whoever supports Him. Allah is Strong and Mighty.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ‌ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ اِنْ مَّكَّنّٰهُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ اَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَمَرُوْا بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِؕ وَلِلّٰهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْاُمُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena im makkannaahum fil-ardi aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata wa'amaroo bil-ma'roofi wanahaw 'anil-munkari walillaahi 'aaqibatul-umoor
ayahs.translationClear: Those who, when We empower them in the land, observe the prayer, and give regular charity, and command what is right, and forbid what is wrong. To Allah belongs the outcome of events.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ يُّكَذِّبُوْكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّثَمُوْدُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in yukadhdhibooka faqad kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa'aadun wathamood
ayahs.translationClear: If they deny you—before them the people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood also denied.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَوْمُ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوْطٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
ayahs.transliteration: Waqawmu ibraaheema waqawmu loot
ayahs.translationClear: And the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ مَدْيَنَ‌ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ‌ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَصْحٰبُ مَدْيَنَۚ وَكُذِّبَ مُوْسٰي فَاَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهُمْۚ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'as'haabu madyana wakudhdhiba moosaa fa'amlaytu lilkaafireena thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana nakeer
ayahs.translationClear: And the inhabitants of Midian. And Moses was denied. Then I reprieved those who disbelieved, but then I seized them. So how was My rejection?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَاَيِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلٰي عُرُوْشِهَا وَبِي͏ٔ͏ْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَّقَصْرٍ مَّشِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin[930] - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.[931]
ayahs.transliteration: Faka'ayyim min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa wahiya zaalimatun fahiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa wabi'rim mu'attalatin waqasrim masheed

footnotes.930: Literally, "fallen in upon its roofs," i.e., after the roofs of its buildings had caved in, the walls collapsed over them.
footnotes.931: i.e., How many wells have been left inoperative, and how many palaces have been emptied of their occupants in the past.

ayahs.translationClear: How many a town have We destroyed while it was doing wrong? They lie in ruins; with stilled wells, and lofty mansions.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا‌ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَتَكُوْنَ لَهُمْ قُلُوْبٌ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ بِهَا͏ٓ اَوْ اٰذَانٌ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ بِهَاۚ فَاِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَي الْاَبْصَارُ وَلٰكِنْ تَعْمَي الْقُلُوْبُ الَّتِيْ فِي الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fatakoona lahum quloobun ya'qiloona bihaa aw aadhaanun yasma'oona bihaa fa'innahaa laa ta'mal-absaaru walaakin ta'mal-quloobul-latee fis-sudoor
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not journeyed in the land, and had minds to reason with, or ears to listen with? It is not the eyes that go blind, but it is the hearts, within the chests, that go blind.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ‌ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَنْ يُّخْلِفَ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهٗؕ وَاِنَّ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَاَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ

words.translation: And they ask you to hasten

ayahs.translation: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayasta'jiloonaka bil-'adhaabi walan yukhlifallaahu wa'dahoo wa'inna yawman 'inda rabbika ka'alfi sanatim mimmaa ta'uddoon
ayahs.translationClear: And they ask you to hasten the punishment. But Allah never breaks His promise. A day with your Lord is like a thousand years of your count.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَاَيِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهَاۚ وَاِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Waka'ayyim min qaryatin amlaytu lahaa wahiya zaalimatun thumma akhadhtuhaa wa'ilayyal-maseer
ayahs.translationClear: How many a town have I reprieved, although it was unjust? Then I seized it. To Me is the destination.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yaa'ayyuhan-naasu innamaa ana lakum nadheerum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “O people, I am only a plain warner to you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّرِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
ayahs.transliteration: Fal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
ayahs.translationClear: Those who believe and work righteousness—for them is forgiveness and a generous provision.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ سَعَوْا فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيْنَ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَحِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure[932] - those are the companions of Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika as'haabul-jaheem

footnotes.932: i.e., trying to undermine their credibility and thereby defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: But those who strive against Our revelations—these are the inmates of Hell.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ‌ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ وَّلَا نَبِيٍّ اِلَّا͏ٓ اِذَا تَمَنّٰٓي اَلْقَي الشَّيْطٰنُ فِيْٓ اُمْنِيَّتِهٖۚ فَيَنْسَخُ اللّٰهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللّٰهُ اٰيٰتِهٖؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses.[933] And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika mir rasoolin walaa nabiyyin illaa idhaa tamannaa alqash-shaytaanu fee umniyyatihee fayansakhullaahu maa yulqish-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimullaahu aayaatihee wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem

footnotes.933: Clarifying those issues which were misunderstood to remove any doubt.

ayahs.translationClear: We never sent a messenger before you, or a prophet, but when he had a desire Satan interfered in his wishes. But Allah nullifies what Satan interjects, and Allah affirms His revelations. Allah is Omniscient and Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ وَّالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَفِيْ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease[934] and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyaj'ala maa yulqish-shaytaanu fitnatal lilladheena fee quloobihim maradun wal-qaasiyati quloobuhum wa'innaz-zaalimeena lafee shiqaaqim ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: In order to make Satan’s suggestions a trial for those whose hearts are diseased, and those whose hearts are hardened. The wrongdoers are in profound discord.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَيُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْا بِهٖ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهٗ قُلُوْبُهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهَادِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: Waliya'lamal-ladheena ootul-'ilma annahul-haqqu mir rabbika fayu'minoo bihee fatukhbita lahoo quloobuhum wa'innallaaha lahaadil-ladheena aamanoo ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: And so that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord, and so believe in it, and their hearts soften to it. Allah guides those who believe to a straight path.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتّٰي تَاْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.[935]
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo fee miryatim minhu hattaa ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum 'adhaabu yawmin 'aqeem

footnotes.935: One which will not be followed by night and therefore will not give birth to a new day, referring to the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve will continue to be hesitant about it, until the Hour comes upon them suddenly, or there comes to them the torment of a desolate Day.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلّٰهِؕ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْؕ فَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِيْ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh;[936] He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-mulku yawma'idhil lillaahi yahkumu baynahum fal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fee jannaatin-na'eem

footnotes.936: None will compete with Him for authority at that time.

ayahs.translationClear: Sovereignty on that Day belongs to Allah; He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَكَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa fa'ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum muheen
ayahs.translationClear: But those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations—these will have a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا‌ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوْٓا اَوْ مَاتُوْا لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللّٰهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًاؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرّٰزِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena haajaroo fee sabeelillaahi thumma qutiloo aw maatoo layarzuqannahumullaahu rizqan hasanan wa'innallaaha lahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
ayahs.translationClear: Those who emigrate in Allah’s cause, then get killed, or die, Allah will provide them with fine provisions. Allah is the Best of providers.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ مُّدْخَلًا يَّرْضَوْنَهٗؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَلِيْمٌ حَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
ayahs.transliteration: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahoo wa'innallaaha la'aleemun haleem
ayahs.translationClear: He will admit them an admittance that will please them. Allah is Knowing and Clement.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَۚ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبَ بِهٖ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنْصُرَنَّهُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.[937]
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika waman 'aaqaba bimithli maa 'ooqiba bihee thumma bughiya 'alayhi layansurannahullaahu innallaaha la'afuwwun ghafoor

footnotes.937: In spite of His ability to take vengeance. The statement contains a suggestion that the believers pardon as well.

ayahs.translationClear: That is so! Whoever retaliates similarly to the affliction he was made to suffer, and then he is wronged again, Allah will definitely assist him. Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُوْلِجُ الَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي الَّيْلِ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيْعٌۢ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: That[938] is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa'annallaaha samee'um baseer

footnotes.938: i.e., Allāh's capability to give assistance or victory to the oppressed.

ayahs.translationClear: That is because Allah merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night, and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنَّ مَا يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ هُوَ الْبَاطِلُ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'anna maa yad'oona min doonihee huwal-baatilu wa'annallaaha huwal-'aliyyul-kabeer
ayahs.translationClear: That is because Allah is the Reality, and what they invoke besides Him is vanity, and because Allah is the Sublime, the Grand.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءًؗ فَتُصْبِحُ الْاَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةًؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَطِيْفٌ خَبِيْرٌ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle[939] and Aware.[940]
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fatusbihul-ardu mukhdarratan innallaaha lateefun khabeer

footnotes.940: Of His creation and of the needs of His creatures.

ayahs.translationClear: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky, and the land becomes green? Allah is Kind and Aware.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيْدُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wa'innallaaha lahuwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Allah is the Rich, the Praised.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَّا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِيْ فِي الْبَحْرِ بِاَمْرِهٖؕ وَيُمْسِكُ السَّمَا࢜ءَ اَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَي الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fil-ardi wal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bi'amrihee wayumsikus-samaa'a an taqa'a 'alal-ardi illaa bi'idhnihee innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofur raheem
ayahs.translationClear: Do you not see that Allah made everything on earth subservient to you? How the ships sail at sea by His command? That He holds up the sky lest it falls on earth—except by His permission? Allah is Gracious towards the people, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَحْيَاكُمْؗ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيْكُمْؕ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُوْرٌ

words.translation: He will cause you to die

ayahs.translation: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee ahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum innal-insaana lakafoor
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who gives you life, then makes you die, then revives you. The human being is unappreciative.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ‌ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ‌ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوْهُ فَلَا يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِي الْاَمْرِ وَادْعُ اِلٰي رَبِّكَؕ اِنَّكَ لَعَلٰي هُدًي مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ

words.translation: So let them not dispute with you
So let them not dispute with you

ayahs.translation: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: Likulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan hum naasikoohu falaa yunaazi'unnaka fil-amri wad'u ilaa rabbika innaka la'alaa hudam mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: For every congregation We have appointed acts of devotion, which they observe. So do not let them dispute with you in this matter. And invite to your Lord; you are upon a straight guidance.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن جَـٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن جَـٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ جٰدَلُوْكَ فَقُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in jaadalooka faqulillaahu a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: But if they dispute with you, say, “Allah is fully aware of what you do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection regarding what you disagree about.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ‌ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ فِيْ كِتٰبٍؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ يَسِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record.[941] Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ta'lam annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaa'i wal-ardi inna dhaalika fee kitaabin inna dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer

footnotes.941: The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: Do you not know that Allah knows everything in the heavens and the earth? This is in a book. That is easy for Allah.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ‌ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهٖ سُلْطٰنًا وَّمَا لَيْسَ لَهُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌؕ وَمَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ مِنْ نَّصِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
ayahs.transliteration: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaanan wamaa laysa lahum bihee 'ilmun wamaa lizzaalimeena min naseer
ayahs.translationClear: Yet they worship, besides Allah, things for which He sent down no warrant, and what they have no knowledge of. There is no savior for the transgressors.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ‌ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا‌ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ‌ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟‌ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا تُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِيْ وُجُوْهِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا الْمُنْكَرَؕ يَكَادُوْنَ يَسْطُوْنَ بِالَّذِيْنَ يَتْلُوْنَ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ قُلْ اَفَاُنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ بِشَرٍّ مِّنْ ذٰلِكُمْؕ اَلنَّارُؕ وَعَدَهَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاؕ وَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that?[942] [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin ta'rifu fee wujoohil-ladheena kafarul-munkara yakaadoona yastoona bil-ladheena yatloona 'alayhim aayaatinaa qul afa'unabbi'ukum bisharrim min dhaalikumun-naaru wa'adahallaahul-ladheena kafaroo wabi'sal-maseer

footnotes.942: i.e., worse than the rage you feel against those who recite Allāh's verses or worse than your threats against them.

ayahs.translationClear: And when Our clear Verses are recited to them, you will recognize disgust on the faces of those who disbelieve. They nearly assault those who recite to them Our Verses. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than that? The Fire! Allah has promised it to those who disbelieve. And what a wretched outcome!”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ‌ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ‌ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوْا لَهٗؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَنْ يَّخْلُقُوْا ذُبَابًا وَّلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوْا لَهٗؕ وَاِنْ يَّسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْـٔ͏ًا لَّا يَسْتَنْقِذُوْهُ مِنْهُؕ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوْبُ

words.translation: and the one who is sought

ayahs.translation: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.[943]
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa'ayyuhan-naasu duriba mathalun fastami'oo lahoo innal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi lan yakhluqoo dhubaaban walawijtama'oo lahoo wa'in yaslubhumudh-dhubaabu shay'al laa yastanqidhoohu minhu da'ufat-taalibu wal-matloob

footnotes.943: A comparison is made here to the worshipper of a false deity and that which he worships.

ayahs.translationClear: O people! A parable is presented, so listen to it: Those you invoke besides Allah will never create a fly, even if they banded together for that purpose. And if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it from it. Weak are the pursuer and the pursued.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيْزٌ
ayahs.translation: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal.[944] Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrihee innallaaha laqawiyyun 'azeez

footnotes.944: They have not assessed Him with the assessment due to Him, meaning that they did not take into account His perfect attributes.

ayahs.translationClear: They do not value Allah as He should be valued. Allah is Strong and Powerful.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ يَصْطَفِيْ مِنَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ رُسُلًا وَّمِنَ النَّاسِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيْعٌۢ بَصِيْرٌ ۚ
